question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

OBLIGING
solution: The correct answer is: **Compliant**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"obliging"** means someone who is willing to help or eager to assist others. It refers to a cooperative or accommodating nature. (सहायक, मददगार) • **Example: **The obliging shopkeeper offered to carry the bags to the car. • **"Compliant"** refers to someone who is willing to comply or follow rules, or who is submissive and accommodating. It aligns closely with the meaning of obliging. (अनुकूल, आज्ञाकारी) • **Example: **She was compliant with all the guidelines set by the committee. • Hence, the synonym for the word **'obliging' **is **'compliant'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Compliant**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Dominant** (प्रमुख, हावी): Refers to someone or something that is more powerful, controlling, or influential than others. • **Example:** The dominant lion ruled over his territory fearlessly. • **Hostile** (शत्रुतापूर्ण, विरोधी): Refers to someone who is unfriendly or antagonistic. • **Example:** The crowd turned hostile when the speaker refused to answer their questions. • **Suspicious** (संदेहपूर्ण, शंकालु): Refers to someone who is inclined to suspect or distrust others. • **Example:** The detective was suspicious of the man's alibi during the investigation. 2f:Ta69, The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Praise)**.
